messages.english: Keep newer crop plans safe when an older app session saves its copy.
messages.translation: Gcina izinhlelo zezitshalo ezintsha ziphephile lapho iseshini endala yohlelo igcina ikhophi yayo.

messages.english: Review retained copies before continuing with your current crop plan.
messages.translation: Bukeza amakhophi agciniwe ngaphambi kokuba uqhubeke nohlelo lwakho lwamanje lwezitshalo.

messages.english: Retry interrupted guest crop transfers without replacing saved account work.
messages.translation: Phinda uzame ukudlulisa umsebenzi wezitshalo wesivakashi onqanyuliwe ngaphandle kokushintsha umsebenzi we-akhawunti ogciniwe.
Uhlelo lokukhiqiza → Indawo yokugcina uhlelo lwezitshalo

messages.english: Check the storage notice. If an older session changed its copy, download both copies and review them before choosing to keep your current plan.
messages.translation: Hlola isaziso sendawo yokugcina. Uma iseshini endala ishintshe ikhophi yayo, dawuniloda amakhophi omabili uwabukeze ngaphambi kokukhetha ukugcina uhlelo lwakho lwamanje.
